title: How Albert Caldwell got the nickname Happy
summary: Caldwell explains he learned to drive cars as a kid around a garage; the garage owner, a violinist and arranger, named him Happy.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: All righty. Now let's begin at the beginning. Today we're interviewing Happy Caldwell. Your real name is Albert, right?
How did you get that nickname, first of all?

Well, as a matter of fact, I was a kid hanging around the garage a half a block from where I lived, and I always used to look out for (unintelligible) cars, and so I learned to drive a car without any instruction. Soon as the guy would get out, I'd take it, you know. Said, where your kid going with the car? Going around the block and come back. He said, oh, my goodness.
So he said, well, never could discourage him, so the fellow that had the garage, name was -- he was a violin player and arranger, and he said, well, we're going to name him Happy, and the name stuck.
Yeah. Maybe because you got a happy disposition.
Well, I always had a -- I always liked to play a little on the happy side of life. Right, you know.
